_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Golf (Card Game) - Player {player_id}.
Goal: Get the lowest total score in this single round. If columns share the same value, they are summed as 0.
Card Values: A=1, 2-10=face value, J/Q=10, K=0

Actions (use exact brackets):
- '[draw]' - Draw from deck
- '[take]' - Take from discard pile
- '[swap X Y]' - Swap drawn card with position X (row) Y (column)
- '[discard]' - Discard the drawn card

board.drew:
You drew: {card}
Now you must [swap X Y] or [discard] it.
board.took:
You took: {card} from discard pile
You must [swap X Y] with it (cannot discard).
board.peeked: မႂ်းလႆႈၶၢဝ်လႅၵ်ႈတီႈဢွင်ႈတီႈ ({row},{col}): {card}

options.final_turns: ပွၵ်ႈလိုၼ်း! ၶေႃႈလၢႆးမႂ်း: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.draw: လွင်ႈလိူၵ်ႈဢၼ်ၸဝ်ႈၵဝ်ႇမီးၼၼ်ႉ [draw], [take]
options.must_swap: You must: [swap X Y] (cannot discard cards from discard pile)
options.swap_or_discard: တေလႆႈ: [swap X Y] ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် [discard]

hand.no_cards: ဢမ်ႇမီးဝႂ်ၵပ်းတူဝ်။

action_desc.swapped: ၽူႈလႄႈ {pid} လႆႈလၢႅၼ်ႈ {new} တင်း {old} တီႈဢွင်ႈတီႈ ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Deck is empty! Game ends immediately.
message.knocked: Player {pid} knocked! Each other player gets one more turn.
message.final_round: Player {pid} {reason}! Each other player gets one more turn.

invalid.wrong_action: Use exactly ONE bracketed action: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], or [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: ၶူဝ်းၶွင်ဢၼ်လႆႈထုၵ်ႇပႅတ်ႈၼၼ်ႉ ဢမ်ႇမီးသင်ယဝ်ႉ!
invalid.must_draw_first: မႂ်းတေလႆႈပွၵ်ႈဢွၼ်တၢင်း [draw], [take], [knock], ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: သူဢမ်ႇၸၢင်ႈဢဝ်လႆႈ ဝႂ်ဢၼ်လုၵ်ႉတီႈ ထုပ်ႉပႅတ်ႈၼၼ်ႉသေ ဢဝ်ၵႂႃႇ။သူတေလႆႈလႅၵ်ႈမၼ်းၶိုၼ်းၵူၺ်းယဝ်ႉ။
invalid.have_drawn_card: You have a drawn card. You must [swap X Y] or [discard] it.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: You need a drawn card to swap.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: You need a drawn card to discard.
invalid.out_of_bounds: ဢွင်ႈတီႈဢမ်ႇပေႃးမီး။ သႂ်ႇၶေႃႈလၢႆး 1-{max_row}, လွၵ်း 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: You cannot knock with a drawn card. Complete your turn first.
invalid.already_knocked: Someone has already knocked this round.
invalid.already_revealed: ၽႅၼ်ႇဢၼ်ၼၼ်ႉ လႆႈပိုတ်ႇၼႄဝႆႉယဝ်ႉ!
